item.title: VA Benefits for Veterans in Anne Arundel County
item.description:
VA Benefits for Veterans in Anne Arundel County

Veterans living in Anne Arundel County have access to extensive VA benefits. From healthcare to education to housing assistance, this guide covers what’s available near Fort Meade and Joint Base Andrews.

VA Healthcare System

VA Medical Facilities Near Anne Arundel

Baltimore VA Medical Center - Primary facility for Anne Arundel veterans

  • Address: 2901 W. Lanham Avenue, Baltimore, MD 21215
  • Phone: 410-455-5000
  • Full medical services
  • About 30-40 minutes from most of Anne Arundel
  • Official VA Facilities: va.gov/health-care/find-locations

item.title: Anne Arundel County Housing Calculator
item.description:
Anne Arundel County Housing Calculator

Understanding housing costs in Anne Arundel County is crucial for budgeting. This guide helps you estimate mortgage payments, rent, and total housing affordability.

Housing Market Overview

Anne Arundel County Housing

Market Type:

  • Competitive suburban market
  • Near Baltimore and DC
  • Strong demand
  • Prices higher than national average

Price Ranges:

Condos/Apartments:

  • 1 bedroom: $180,000-300,000
  • 2 bedroom: $250,000-400,000
  • 3 bedroom: $350,000-500,000+

Single Family Homes:

  • 2-3 bedroom: $350,000-550,000
  • 4 bedroom: $500,000-800,000+
  • Luxury/waterfront: $800,000-2,000,000+
